visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with real-life footage featuring a young woman with black hair tied in pigtails. She is wearing a black long-sleeved athletic shirt and stands in front of a blue and black motorcycle. She looks directly at the camera, gesturing with her hands while holding two small camera devices—one white and one black. The setting is an outdoor area with a white van and a corrugated metal wall in the background under bright natural daylight. (2) A hand holds a small, white, pill-shaped camera and inserts it into the interior cheek padding of a motorcycle helmet. The helmet is NHK brand, decorated with vibrant purple, green, and yellow graphics. A stylized graphic background of orange and yellow light rays appears during this action, creating a dynamic, high-energy visual effect. (3) The woman is shown holding the helmet and pointing to the concealed camera inside the chin guard. She smiles broadly with animated facial expressions. Close-up shots show the camera being adjusted within the helmet's inner lining. She then puts the helmet on, which has a reflective iridescent visor, demonstrating how the camera sits unobtrusively near her face. (4) The scene shifts to a racetrack where the woman is riding a blue motorcycle at high speeds. The footage alternates between third-person follow shots showing her in a professional racing suit and POV shots from the helmet-mounted camera. The POV shots display the handlebars, the curved track, and other riders in the distance. The environment consists of a paved track, green grass, and barriers with brand signage under a clear sky.
